1 Game Data

Theme Hospital itself is not included. Select your Theme Hospital full version ZIP or extracted game folder (available from GOG.com or EA). The demo version is not supported. Files are stored locally in your browser and never leave your machine.

Project Notes & Match Information Show
This open-source project is hosted on GitHub (akadawa/BTHVS) — bug reports, feedback, and feature requests are welcome and will gladly be implemented. Currently running serverless on Vercel for prototype testing, while a dedicated multiplayer server is in active roadmap development to deliver persistent matches and authoritative synchronization.
Note: Local hospital faxes and year-end reports run seamlessly without interrupting rivals. Explicit game speed toggles (Pause / Normal via Options or P) synchronize across all players.
